scores.notes: Both show the same open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, patched cream sail and rope-bound stern post on a dark choppy lake under storm cloud with low hilly shores; the right only adds the clearing asked for.

Same dark storm sky, grey-green heaving sea and wet brown seabed strewn with weed; the left looks from the near shore (palms, distant walled town) and the right down the corridor to a far red-cliff shore, which do not conflict.
Both show a sandy, puddled seabed path between tall curling blue-green water walls with a tan/red bluff at the shore end; the left sky is stormier but the terrain, puddles and water walls match.

Both show dry Galilean hill country with olive trees, a pale dirt road and flat-roofed stone houses; the left is the road some way off with the farmstead in the distance, the right is the yard of such a house, a compatible closer viewpoint.

Moses (centre with staff, left; on the rock with raised staff, right) is in both an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, same build, cream tunic and dark brown cloak; hair looks more windswept and longer on the right but no clear cue conflicts.

Both show a sandy, rock-and-weed-strewn seabed opening between curling blue-green water walls under storm cloud; the right is the shore view with wind-bent palms as the sea divides, the left the corridor toward far red cliffs, a compatible change of viewpoint.

Moses (pointing from the bank, left; front centre with staff, right) is in both an elderly man with shoulder-length white hair and a long full white beard, same build and tanned skin, in a cream tunic with a brown cloak.

Both show a hill-ringed lake shore with a stony bank, reeds at the waterline, a small fire and the same wooden boat close in under heavy cloud; the left is sunlit with a hillside village behind and the right dimmer and seen along the beach, but nothing in the land or water conflicts.

The lake, storm and hills agree, but the boat itself conflicts: on the left the stern where Jesus sleeps ends in a short plain rope-bound post, on the right it rises into a tall carved scroll finial with a different, heavier hull.

Daniel (beside the angel, left; being lifted from the pit, right) is in both an older lean man with short cropped grey hair and a short grey beard in a blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder bag; skin reads a little darker on the left but no clear cue conflicts.

Daniel (climbing the rope, left; standing among the lions, right) is in both a lean older man with short grey hair and a trimmed grey beard, tan skin, in the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a belt pouch.

Peter (standing by the fire with the net over his shoulder, left; leaping from the boat, right) has in both curly dark hair heavily streaked grey, a short grizzled beard, a weathered middle-aged face and sturdy build, with a rough brown coat.

Daniel (standing among the lions, left; held by the soldiers on the rope, right) is in both an older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, slim build, in a blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder bag.

Both show a tan sandy seabed with weed, shells and rocks opening through blue-green sea by a desert shore with reddish cliffs; the left is the dark stormy night of the parting from the bank and the right the opened corridor in grey daylight, with no conflicting land feature.

Peter (plunging from the boat, left; standing by the fire holding the net, right) has in both short dark curly hair going grey, a short grizzled beard, a tanned weathered middle-aged face and sturdy build, in a rough brown outer coat.

Both show the same plank-built boat with a rope-lashed stern post and single stayed mast in steep blue-green waves under dark rain cloud with scrubby green hills behind; the sail is above the frame on the left and visible on the right.

Both show a storm-dark teal sea split over a wet tan seabed beside a dry desert coast; the left looks down the corridor toward red cliffs and the right from the palm-fringed bank as the waters open, viewpoints that do not conflict.

Both show the same plank-built open boat with a rope-lashed stern post, long oars and a single stayed mast on a dark blue wave-tossed lake under storm cloud with scrubby hills on both shores; the left only adds the clearing asked for.

Jesus (standing in the boat, left; crouching at the fire, right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face, age and skin tone, and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.
Both show a wet sandy path between towering green wave walls under a dark storm sky leading back to red sandstone cliffs on the far shore.

Both show a calm lake shore with a small fire, backed by terraced tan cliffs and a flat-roofed village with cypresses and palms on a point to the right; left is seen from the pebbly beach and right from the water.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same slim face and build, and a blue-grey cloak over a white tunic in both the boat scene and the fire scene.

Both show a small open wooden boat with one mast on a grey-green lake under storm cloud with low tan hills and a small village on the shore; the sail is furled on the left and set on the right, a change that fits the two moments.

Left shows a pale stone house courtyard opening onto green hills and a distant lake; right shows a stony hill road with olive trees, the same kind of flat-roofed stone houses and a distant lake between hills, which fits the same hillside.

Both show the same kind of open wooden boat with a single mast and rope-wrapped stern post on a dark heaving sea beneath storm cloud with dark headlands behind; the sail is furled left and flying right.
The lake and hills are compatible, but the boat conflicts: on the left it has a tall carved scroll-shaped sternpost rising above the men's heads, on the right both ends are short plain square posts.

Peter (standing by the fire on the left, leaping from the boat on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned middle-aged face and stocky build, with a brown cloak in both.

Both show a deep circular pit of large grey stone blocks with a sandy rubble floor, open to daylight above, with a parapet at the rim where the king and guards look down; the winch on the left and wooden hatch on the right are compatible.

Left is a sunlit corridor under a clear blue sky running back to bare red mesas; right is the shore under a black storm sky with palms, sandy bluffs and a hilltop town, so both the weather and the shore the path starts from conflict.

Both show an open circular pit lined with pale weathered stone blocks, a sandy floor with lions, a parapet where the king leans and palms and dry ground above; the wooden doors at the rim on the left and barred gate on the right fit different sides of the pit.

Both show pale flat-roofed stone farm buildings among dry-stone walls, olive trees and terraced green-tan hills under a clear sky; the left sees the house from the road and the right from its paved yard, where arches come into view.

Both show the same dark open wooden boat with a single mast, tattered sail and square rope-bound sternpost by the sleeper's cushion, in black-green breaking waves under a rain-dark sky with dark cliffed shores.

Both show the same dark open boat with a mast carrying a furled pale sail on its yard and a square rope-bound end post, in dark green breaking waves under storm cloud with dark cliffed headlands behind.

Moses is an elderly man with thinning white hair and a full white beard, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a crook-topped staff in both; on the left he is seen from behind in part-profile, but hair, beard and age agree.

Both show a sunken open-air pit lined with grey stone blocks holding lions, with palms and sandy ground at the rim where the king stands; the left looks wider and has a wooden door in the wall, the right is seen from above as a tighter ring, which viewpoint can cover.
Jesus has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard and slim face, with a dark blue cloak over a pale tunic, seated by the fire on the left and standing in the boat on the right.

Both show a shell-strewn sandy seabed between tall green wave walls in daylight, running back to the same flat-topped red sandstone mesas on a sandy far shore; the sky is a little cloudier on the left.

Both show a wet sandy rock-strewn path between rearing dark blue-green waves under a black storm sky, flanked by a tan sandy bluff on the left; the left is the shore as the sea opens and the right is further into the corridor.
Both show a calm blue lake shore in clear daylight with a small fire on a pebbly sandy beach, pale stone flat-roofed houses, olive trees and dark cypresses on a tan hillside behind.
